cases.sentence: ___, однако ж, оказался милостивее, чем можно было ожидать, судя по совершенному преступлению.
cases.translation: The sentence, however, turned out to be more lenient than could have been expected, given the gravity of the crime committed.
cases.explain: "Приговор" is the subject of "оказался" (turned out), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Со дня ___ его прошло почти полтора года.
cases.translation: Almost a year and a half had passed since the day of his crime.
cases.explain: "Преступления" is genitive, modifying "дня" (the day of the crime).

cases.sentence: Их родственники, приезжавшие в город, оставляли, по ___ их, в руках Сони вещи для них и даже деньги.
cases.translation: Their relatives, who came to town, left belongings and even money for them in Sonya's hands, following their instructions.
cases.explain: "Указанию" is dative because of the preposition "по" (according to their instructions).

cases.sentence: Дуня выдумала вместе с Разумихиным для матери целую ___ об отъезде Раскольникова.
cases.translation: Dunya invented, together with Razumikhin, a whole story for their mother about Raskolnikov's departure.
cases.explain: "Историю" is accusative as the direct object of "выдумала" (invented a story).

cases.sentence: Он ходил за оставшимся в живых старым и расслабленным ___ умершего товарища.
cases.translation: He looked after the elderly, weakened father of his deceased friend, who was still living.
cases.explain: "Отцом" is instrumental because of the preposition "за" (looked after the father).

cases.sentence: В ___ уже девять месяцев заключен ссыльно-каторжный второго разряда, Родион Раскольников.
cases.translation: In the prison, the second-class penal convict Rodion Raskolnikov has already been confined for nine months.
cases.explain: "Остроге" is prepositional because of the preposition "в" (in the prison).

reading.ru: На берегу широкой, пустынной реки стоит город, один из административных центров России; в городе крепость, в крепости острог.
reading.question: Where is Raskolnikov now, at the start of the Epilogue?
options: In a Siberian town with a fortress and prison, on the bank of a wide river
On a ship bound for America
reading.correct: In a Siberian town with a fortress and prison, on the bank of a wide river
reading.explain: The Epilogue opens describing a Siberian town on a wide river, containing a fortress and, within it, a prison.

reading.ru: В остроге уже девять месяцев заключен ссыльно-каторжный второго разряда, Родион Раскольников.
reading.question: How long has Raskolnikov been imprisoned at the start of the Epilogue?
reading.correct: Nine months
reading.explain: The text states that Raskolnikov, a second-class penal convict, has already been confined there for nine months.

reading.ru: Со дня преступления его прошло почти полтора года.
reading.question: How much time has passed since Raskolnikov's crime?
options: Almost a year and a half
reading.correct: Almost a year and a half
reading.explain: Almost a year and a half had passed since the day of his crime.

reading.ru: Преступник твердо, точно и ясно поддерживал свое показание, не запутывая обстоятельств, не смягчая их в свою пользу, не искажая фактов, не забывая малейшей подробности.
reading.question: How did Raskolnikov behave during the legal proceedings?
options: He gave firm, precise, and clear testimony without distorting facts
He refused to speak at all
reading.correct: He gave firm, precise, and clear testimony without distorting facts
reading.explain: He maintained his testimony firmly, precisely and clearly, without confusing the facts or softening them in his own favor.

reading.ru: Одним словом, дело вышло ясное.
reading.question: How does the narrator summarize the outcome of the investigation?
options: The case turned out to be clear
reading.correct: The case turned out to be clear
reading.explain: The narrator sums up that, in a word, the case turned out to be a clear one.

reading.ru: Тут, кстати, подоспела новейшая модная теория временного умопомешательства, которую так часто стараются применять в наше время к иным преступникам.
reading.question: What fashionable theory is invoked to explain Raskolnikov's crime?
reading.correct: The theory of temporary insanity
reading.explain: The newest fashionable theory of temporary insanity, often applied to criminals of the time, conveniently came into play.

reading.ru: Приговор, однако ж, оказался милостивее, чем можно было ожидать, судя по совершенному преступлению
reading.question: How does the sentence handed down compare to expectations?
options: It was more lenient than expected given the crime
It matched exactly what was expected
reading.correct: It was more lenient than expected given the crime
reading.explain: The sentence turned out to be more merciful than one might have expected, considering the crime committed.

reading.ru: Бывший студент Разумихин откопал откуда-то сведения и представил доказательства, что преступник Раскольников, в бытность свою в университете, из последних средств своих помогал одному своему бедному и чахоточному университетскому товарищу и почти содержал его в продолжение полугода.
reading.question: What favorable evidence did Razumikhin uncover about Raskolnikov?
options: That Raskolnikov had supported a poor, consumptive university friend for half a year
That Raskolnikov had donated to charity
That Raskolnikov had saved a drowning child
That Raskolnikov had once saved Porfiry's life
reading.correct: That Raskolnikov had supported a poor, consumptive university friend for half a year
reading.explain: Razumikhin dug up evidence that Raskolnikov, while at university, had supported a poor consumptive fellow student with his last resources for about six months.

reading.ru: Одним словом, кончилось тем, что преступник присужден был к каторжной работе второго разряда, на срок всего только восьми лет, во уважение явки с повинною и некоторых облегчающих вину обстоятельств.
reading.question: What sentence does Raskolnikov ultimately receive?
options: Eight years of second-class penal servitude
reading.correct: Eight years of second-class penal servitude
reading.explain: He was sentenced to second-class penal servitude for a term of only eight years, in consideration of his voluntary confession and mitigating circumstances.

reading.ru: Еще в начале процесса мать Раскольникова сделалась больна.
reading.question: What happens to Raskolnikov's mother during the trial?
reading.correct: She falls ill
reading.explain: Even at the start of the legal process, Raskolnikov's mother fell ill.

reading.ru: Дуня и Разумихин нашли возможным увезти ее из Петербурга на всё время суда.
reading.question: What do Dunya and Razumikhin decide to do with the mother during the trial?
options: Take her away from Petersburg for the duration of the trial
Send her to live with Sonya
reading.correct: Take her away from Petersburg for the duration of the trial
reading.explain: Dunya and Razumikhin found it best to take her away from Petersburg for the whole time of the trial.

reading.ru: Болезнь Пульхерии Александровны была какая-то странная, нервная и сопровождалась чем-то вроде помешательства, если не совершенно, то, по крайней мере, отчасти.
reading.question: What was unusual about Pulkheria Alexandrovna's illness?
options: It was nervous in nature and accompanied by something like partial derangement
It was purely physical with no mental symptoms
reading.correct: It was nervous in nature and accompanied by something like partial derangement
reading.explain: Her illness was strange and nervous, accompanied by something resembling derangement, if not wholly then at least partly.

reading.ru: Дуня увидела наконец, что трудно лгать и выдумывать, и пришла к окончательному заключению, что лучше уж совершенно молчать об известных пунктах
reading.question: What conclusion does Dunya reach about discussing certain topics with her mother?
options: That it is better to stay completely silent on certain points
That she should tell her mother the whole truth
That Razumikhin should handle all conversations
That she should move away entirely
reading.correct: That it is better to stay completely silent on certain points
reading.explain: Dunya realized it was hard to keep lying and inventing stories, and concluded it was best to remain entirely silent about certain points.

reading.ru: Пять месяцев спустя после явки преступника с повинной последовал его приговор.
reading.question: How long after Raskolnikov's confession did the sentence follow?
reading.correct: Five months
reading.explain: The sentence followed five months after the criminal's voluntary confession.

reading.ru: Он и Соня наконец отправились.
reading.question: Who finally sets off together at the end of paragraph six?
reading.correct: Raskolnikov and Sonya
reading.explain: The text states that he (Raskolnikov) and Sonya finally set off, presumably for Siberia.

reading.ru: Два месяца спустя Дунечка вышла замуж за Разумихина.
reading.question: What happens two months after Raskolnikov departs?
reading.correct: Dunechka marries Razumikhin
reading.explain: Two months later, Dunechka married Razumikhin.

reading.ru: Свадьба была грустная и тихая.
reading.question: What was the mood of Dunya and Razumikhin's wedding?
reading.correct: Sad and quiet
reading.explain: The wedding is described as sad and quiet.

reading.ru: Чрез две недели она умерла.
reading.question: How long after falling ill in a fever did Pulkheria Alexandrovna die?
reading.correct: Two weeks
reading.explain: The text states that two weeks after the fever set in, she died.

reading.ru: Раскольников долго не знал о смерти матери, хотя корреспонденция с Петербургом установилась еще с самого начала водворения его в Сибири.
reading.question: Did Raskolnikov learn of his mother's death right away?
options: No, he did not know for a long time, even though correspondence with Petersburg had been established
Yes, he was informed immediately by telegram
Yes, Sonya told him in person the same week
reading.correct: No, he did not know for a long time, even though correspondence with Petersburg had been established
reading.explain: Raskolnikov did not learn of his mother's death for a long time, although correspondence with Petersburg had been set up from the very start of his time in Siberia.

reading.ru: Вдруг, в последнем письме, Соня написала, что он заболел весьма серьезно и лежит в госпитале, в арестантской палате…
reading.question: What alarming news does Sonya report in her last letter mentioned in this chapter?
options: That Raskolnikov has fallen seriously ill and is in the prisoners' hospital ward
That Raskolnikov refuses to see her anymore
reading.correct: That Raskolnikov has fallen seriously ill and is in the prisoners' hospital ward
reading.explain: Suddenly, in her last letter, Sonya wrote that he had fallen seriously ill and was lying in the hospital, in the convicts' ward.
